# toona

> > AI-powered platform for creating animated manga and motion comics with upscaling and frame interpolation tools

toona provides AI tools specifically designed for anime and manga creators, featuring the anime6b upscaler for 4K/8K video enhancement and automated keyframe interpolation for bringing static manga panels to life. The platform integrates with Discord and supports multiple video formats including MP4, MOV, and WebM.

## Key Topics

- AI anime video upscaling
- Frame interpolation and inbetweening
- Manga to animation conversion
- anime6b upscaler
- 4K and 8K video enhancement
- Keyframe automation
- Motion comics creation
- Image-to-video generation
- Anime content creation tools
- Video quality enhancement
- Manga colorization
- Discord integration
- MP4/MOV/WebM support

## Core Platform

- [toona](https://toona.io/): AI-powered platform for creating animated manga and motion comics

## AI Video Tools

- [toona | upscale video](https://toona.io/video-upscale): AI anime video upscaler supporting 4K/8K enhancement with anime6b
- [toona | inbetween](https://toona.io/inbetween): AI keyframe interpolation tool for animating manga panels automatically
